text:
lena_csm: Hey @omar_revops — Meridian Labs wants to accelerate their renewal and prepay a short deposit to lock pricing. They want the contract to start next month. Can we do a deposit invoice + split billing for the remainder? Need legal-approved amendment and an onboarding window note.

omar_revops: Quick clarifying Qs — which billing entity (US/EU) and will they pay by PO or card for the deposit? If PO, vendor code and PO number please.

niko_sales: They prefer PO for audit reasons but said card is a fallback. Billing entity: Meridian Labs, US. PO number looks like `PO-9321` according to the buyer. Seat increase from 45 -> 60 effective 2026-04-01.

lena_csm: Confirming seat add + effective 2026-04-01. Proposal from customer: deposit = 2 months MRR on the new seat count, remainder invoiced monthly. We want legal to OK the amendment and route for signature.

omar_revops: Got it. Draft invoice lines I'll propose: 
```
1) Deposit (2 months) - 60 seats @ $125/seat = $15,000
2) Monthly subscription (prorated start) - credit applied after deposit
```
If they send PO, include `Meridian PO-9321` in invoice. Default payment terms Net30 unless they request Net45.

legal_bot: Note — any change to pricing/term requires a signed amendment. We'll prepare a 1-page amendment that: 1) updates seat count, 2) documents deposit applied as credit to first N invoices, 3) includes refund rule if canceled within 30 days. Need authorized signer name + email. Also check if we need a Data Processing Addendum (DPA).

niko_sales: Buyer confirmed CFO (Marla Diaz) will sign, email marla.diaz@meridian.com. They do not anticipate a DPA for this customer. I will confirm CC on PO for accounting team.

jess_engineer: Heads-up for onboarding: our standard queue is heavy around 2026-04-01. If they want an accelerated enablement session we need to reserve a trainer (adds $1k). Otherwise earliest standard kickoff is 2026-04-08.

lena_csm: Thanks — I'll offer two kickoff options (accelerated w/ trainer 04-01 or standard 04-08). @niko_sales please confirm with CFO which they prefer.

omar_revops: I'll create the invoice draft and attach `Meridian PO-9321` placeholder. Routing: send PO to finance@redwood.com and cc me. If they pay by card, we can process immediately and trigger the amendment for signature.

niko_sales: Confirmed with CFO — they'll send PO, prefer standard kickoff 04-08. I'll share PO scan when it arrives.

legal_bot: Preparing amendment now with the deposit-credit wording and 30-day refund clause. Will queue DocuSign once PO or signer's confirmation is posted.

lena_csm: Great. I'll update the customer with proposed kickoff 2026-04-08 and note deposit/PO path. Will post PO scan and signer's confirmation here when received. :thumbsup:

omar_revops: Thanks — tracking internally as `renewal/meridian/2026-04-deposit`. I'll attach invoice draft to the thread when ready.

lena_csm: Closing loop for now. Next steps: @niko_sales to post PO scan, @legal_bot to send DocuSign amendment, @omar_revops to send invoice. We'll reconvene if any exceptions.
